_doc: Revert-verify mutants for req c05a3565-7b8d-42dc-bc9f-7e71d47d9364 (issue #4441), CLI-adapter half. Each mutant removes ONE of the three things the fix introduced — the CRLF-tolerant fences, the BOM skip, the SHARED normalisation — and the expectation below was written BEFORE the run (sparql-iri-form-pre-verify §A18). ⛔ The axis names are the machine key: red_re reads the name right after `›`, so every axis is named `B<n>` as its FIRST token (§A47/§A104). ⛤ The NoteToRDFConverter half cannot live here — mutant-driver takes ONE subject — it is issue-4441-crlf-bom.converter.spec.json.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/adapters/FileSystemVaultAdapter.ts

M1_fences_back_to_literal_lf._note: The pre-fix regex. Only the CRLF axes redden: the BOM skip is untouched, so BOM+LF shapes (B2, B5, B10, B13, B14) stay green — that asymmetry is what proves the two halves of the fix are separately load-bearing. B9 reddens through its BOM+CRLF case as well as its CRLF one.

M2_bom_never_skipped._note: Type-preserving (still returns a number), so no type-narrowing is lost and a BROKEN verdict cannot be confused with redness (§A36/§A97). Every BOM axis reddens; the pure-CRLF and pure-LF axes stay green.

M3_diagnostic_path_gets_its_own_regex.to:
const blockBody = /^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---/.exec(content)?.[1];
    if (blockBody === undefined) return null;
M3_diagnostic_path_gets_its_own_regex._note: Simulates the failure mode the requirement exists to prevent: the READ path normalised, the DIAGNOSTIC path not. The read path still returns null for a malformed CRLF/BOM block, so the file is invisible AND unnamed — exactly the silent drop #4439 closed for its own trigger. The anchor includes the following `if` line because the same two-line assignment also appears in updateFrontmatter, and a mutation that lands twice is a defect in the mutant, not a verdict about the axis.

M6_predicate_loses_its_start_anchor._note: Guards the OVER-WIDENING direction — the class the #4439 review already caught once. Without `^`, a `---` fence sitting inside a code block in the BODY is read as the asset's frontmatter. Exists so B7 is not a vacuously-green control: it is the only axis that can see this, which is what makes it load-bearing. ⛤ B6 and B8 stay green under every mutant here BY CONSTRUCTION — they assert the ABSENCE of a side effect, and such an axis is legitimately green in both directions (integration-test-revert-verify §ось на ОТСУТСТВИЕ побочного эффекта). Their product is the pin itself, not a flip.

M4_write_path_drops_the_bom._note: Keeps the BOM out of the MATCH but lets the splice start at 0, so an unrelated property write silently eats the byte. Narrow by construction: only the BOM round-trip axis can see it, which is what makes B10 non-redundant with B2.
